description: Ghandhara Tyre and Rubber Company Limited — The General Tyre and Rubber Company of Pakistan until its name change — is the country's first and largest automotive tyre manufacturer, producing steel-belted tubeless radial tyres for cars, SUVs and 4x4 vehicles and bias-ply tyres for light trucks, trucks and buses, tractors, rickshaws, motorcycles, excavators and OTR applications. It was established in 1963 by General Tire International Corporation of the USA at Landhi, Karachi and began production in July 1964; in September 2024 it entered a seven-year technical assistance agreement with Shandong Huasheng Rubber Co. Ltd. of China.
headOffice: H-23/2, Landhi Industrial Trading Estate, Landhi, Karachi, Pakistan
